parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, used to control water flow.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature or flow rate.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts to open and close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, typically used for hot or cold water control.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates the flow of either hot or cold water depending on the plumbing configuration.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts to adjust the water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the internal plumbing to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs to direct water flow.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper frame section of the faucet spout made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and aesthetic shape to the faucet spout.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part that does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the right switch, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It anchors the switch handle to the sink or countertop and houses the valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the switch handle above it moves.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the left switch, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the left switch handle and connects it to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during faucet operation.
